chapter_title: Case Studies A — Tülu 3 and Llama 3
course_outline_concepts: Tülu 3 (Lambert 2024): 939K-sample SFT mix composition, multi-seed + decontam, full recipe-disclosure
Tülu 3.1 delta: what changed between releases and why
Llama 3 multi-round RSFT: 6 rounds SFT + rejection sampling + DPO; data flywheel between rounds
Per-round data composition: synthetic/human ratio shift across rounds
Why multi-round beats single-pass: what each round's evals caught

sources.what_to_extract: Three-stage pipeline (SFT → DPO → RLVR); SFT = 939,344 prompts, 57% public / 43% synthetic; DPO β=5.0 length-normalized, LR 5e-7; RLVR PPO LR=3e-7, β_KL=0.05, clip 0.2, K=4, GAE λ=0.95, 10M episodes; verifier domains (math / IFEval / code).

Tülu 3.1 is a single-stage update, not a family refresh; only change = swap final PPO → GRPO, remove the reward model from the final stage, hparam retune; parent is Llama-3.1-Tulu-3-8B-DPO; RLVR training set allenai/RLVR-GSM-MATH-IF-Mixed-Constraints.

Tülu 3.1 as a multi-base refresh (Llama 3.1 + OLMo 2 bases); recipe unchanged; DR Tulu (2025) is the deep-research follow-up; Ai2 does not publish per-base-model hyperparameter deltas for the 3.1 refresh.

Per-source prompt counts (18 components totalling 939,344): CoCoNot 10,983; FLAN v2 89,982; No Robots 9,500; OpenAssistant Guanaco 7,132; Aya 100,000; WildChat GPT-4 100,000; TableGPT 5,000; SciRIFF 10,000; NuminaMath-TIR 64,312; WildGuardMix 50,000; Evol CodeAlpaca 107,276; Persona MATH 149,960; Persona GSM 49,980; Persona Python 34,999; Persona Algebra 20,000; Persona IF 29,980; WildJailbreak 50,000; Hardcoded 240. Skill-mix-first, then merge, decontam, downsample.

Bucket shares (Chat 27, Math 21, Code 14, Precise IF 11, Safety 10, Multilingual 7, Reasoning 10%); decontam (8-gram ≥50% or embed >0.9); SFT hparams (seq 4096, LR 5e-6 @ 8B / 2e-6 @ 70B, 2 epochs, FSDP, packing, response-only loss); ablations (drop Persona-Math → -15 GSM8K; drop code → -12 HumanEval; drop safety → WildJailbreak 98% → 52%).
Fully-open ethos; three-stage pipeline framing; Tülu 3 8B/70B/405B matches or beats Llama 3.1 Instruct; RLVR gains +5–10pp GSM8K, +~4pp IFEval vs DPO-only.

Persona-driven prompt-factory (sample persona × skill template → GPT-4o / Claude-3.5 as generator); 57/43 public/synthetic split; response generation uses GPT-4o for general and Claude-3.5-Sonnet for coding; Tülu-3-405B surpasses DeepSeek-V3 on several IF measures.

Six iterative rounds of SFT → Rejection Sampling → DPO; K=10–30 samples per prompt at T=0.6–1.0 scored by RM; DPO LR=1e-5, β=0.1, NLL coef 0.2, single epoch, most-recent-batch only; reward model trained from pretrained checkpoint with linear head + margin labels (significantly/better/slightly/negligibly); per-round data 50–80% synthetic; 405B flagship.

Post-training loop = generate → reject → rank → retrain; prompt quality and annotation QA have outsized impact; synthetic-data-kit CLI (ingest / create / curate / save-as); factuality pipeline turns consistently-wrong informative answers into refusals; Meta does NOT publish per-round synthetic mix.

RLVR formalism r(x,y)=v(x,y); three verifier domains (math grader, IFEval regex, code unit-test sandbox); Tülu 3 8B vs Llama-3.1 8B Instruct numbers (GSM8K 87.6 vs 84.7, MATH 43.7 vs 41.5, IFEval 82.4 vs 80.5); verifier-loophole failure mode.
